description.value:
You create a dancer emoji that inspires all that follow in its footsteps. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it on each subsequent turn, the dancer emoji Flies or Strides up to 20 feet, leaving a trail of glowing dance floor in each space it travels through that lingers for the duration. Allies who enter the trail or start their turn there gain a +5-foot status bonus to their Speeds until the end of the turn. An ally who starts to Fly or Stride on the trail and doesn't leave it for the entire movement also gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC until the start of their next turn, mimicking the dancer's graceful movements.
